name: Paula Jennings

five_sec.what_is_it: An app to keep your recipes, plan meals and make a grocery list.
five_sec.who_for: Organized home cooks. The lady with the notebook.
five_sec.trust_why: 4.8 on the App Store, and it says 'no card required' right there under the headline.
five_sec.next_step: Scroll down to see if they give you recipes or you bring your own.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's a notebook-and-phone picture and 'Grocery Lists'. Not a box in sight, thank the Lord.

full_page.what_stopped_me: It's 'your recipes, your schedule, your plan'. I'd have to go find all the recipes myself, and the whole reason I liked HelloFresh was somebody else picking.
full_page.whats_missing: Ready-made weekly menus, and whether it works with Harris Teeter. The grocery delivery part doesn't name a single store.

PTE.quote: 'No surprise renewals: we don't auto-bill when your year ends.' Honey, put that on a billboard. But I'd have to dig up every recipe myself.

five_sec.what_is_it: Something that plans the week's dinners, lets everybody in the house vote by text, and fills your grocery cart.
five_sec.who_for: Families. My son would actually answer a text faster than he answers me.
five_sec.trust_why: Plain and honest-sounding: 'We don't deliver food' and 'no card needed'. Never heard of them though.
five_sec.next_step: 'See a sample week', I want to know if the food is boring.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It says so in green, 'We don't deliver food. We plan your week and send your grocery list.' So I'm still cooking and shopping, which, fine.

full_page.what_stopped_me: Nothing stops me signing up since it's free, but the sample week is chicken tenders, English muffin pizzas and pasta. That's little-kid food, and I'm cutting carbs. And Harris Teeter isn't named; it just says 'Kroger cart on Family'.
full_page.whats_missing: A grown-up or lower-carb sample week, and Harris Teeter by name.

DD.quote: 'Will I be charged by surprise? No.' That's my whole HelloFresh life right there. Now just show me something besides English muffin pizzas.

five_sec.what_is_it: Meal plans, I think, with a video of a mama and her little girl.
five_sec.trust_why: Pretty and normal. I'd have to read more.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: 'Choose Your Meals' and a phone with a list on it. Doesn't look like a box.

full_page.what_stopped_me: I could not find a price without opening the FAQ, and the trial is the kind that turns into a subscription. I've been burned on that with HelloFresh.
full_page.whats_missing: The price on the page, and Harris Teeter (I did see the Kroger logo).

EM.quote: A Low Carb plan and Greek chicken thighs with olives, now that's HelloFresh variety. But I scrolled all over and never saw a price.

five_sec.what_is_it: An app that decides dinner for you.
five_sec.trust_why: 90,000 families sounds big, but I don't know what the CEO letter has to do with dinner.
five_sec.next_step: Scroll to the FAQ for price.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's a menu on a phone with little message bubbles.

full_page.what_stopped_me: $25 a month and you count messages. And the FAQ says the AI writes the recipe for you. I'd rather have a recipe somebody's actually cooked.
full_page.whats_missing: Harris Teeter or Kroger, and a normal price.

OL.quote: Counting messages like my old flip phone plan. $25 a month is half a HelloFresh box, and I'd still be cooking all of it.

five_sec.what_is_it: HelloFresh. I know it too well.
five_sec.who_for: Folks who want dinner in a box. Me, for now.
five_sec.trust_why: The food really is good. But 'Open a box to reveal your offer' is a gimmick and they know it.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Boxes in the pop-up and bowls of food behind it.

full_page.what_stopped_me: I'm already a customer trying to get out. The fine print says auto-renewing, shipping after the first box, and the price hides behind a zip code.

HF.quote: 'Pause or cancel anytime.' Well, I paused, and a box still showed up on my porch. Now there's a mystery-box game before I can see the menu.

dd_offer.why: Free stays free, the family texting part is free two weeks, no card, and the FAQ says I go back to the free plan.
dd_offer.expect_day_15: The texting and the Kroger cart stop and I'm back on the free one. Nobody charges me since they don't have my card. I think they'd email me first.

head_to_head.reason: It plans the week and sends it to my cart without a box showing up when I didn't ask for one, and it's free to try for real.

EM.reason: eMeals has better grown-up variety, but DinnerDrop shows the price and can't surprise-charge me.

PTE.reason: DinnerDrop hands me the dinners; Plan to Eat makes me find them.

OL.reason: Free versus $25 a month for counted messages.

HF.reason: No skip calendar to fight and no boxes I didn't want.

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page 'See a week' tabs: add a grown-up / lower-carb sample week (not just kid food), and name Harris Teeter next to 'Kroger cart on Family'.
